x: Making up the squad that gained the team 'gold' was Jonathon Scott, 5th individual. Yet another medal was earned in this meeting - the Under 17 'silver' - which went to Robert Peacock.

Nigel Whorlow competed for England in his first International in the Under 16 Boys 3km event, coming 5th in a time of 15:32, and helped the England team to the gold medals. He also took the club teams gold medal with Jonathon Scott as his team mate. England lost the overall match by 4 points 63-67.
